biased-failure.observation: Faulty recorder maps every latent binary outcome to one. The recorded mean is identically one; it targets latent probability0.9, so variance0 and bias0.1.

exact-failure.observation: Independent Bernoulli(0.5) readings, exact unbiased mean

exact-pass.observation: Independent Bernoulli(0.5) readings, exact unbiased mean

loose-bound-unknown.observation: Each reading has marginal Bernoulli(0.5), with unrestricted dependence. The bounded mean has variance between0 and0.25; both endpoints attainable with balanced-total and all-equal laws respectively.

missing-support.observation: Conditional iid Bernoulli calculation as exact-pass; qualification of the actual fixed denominator is unresolved. This is not a verified realized acquisition.

estimator: Arithmetic mean of n registered binary readings, estimating the underlying registered process probability. The observation mechanism and its bias are declared separately.
numerical_derivation: Unbiased iid sample mean has variance p(1-p)/n. A constant observed value has variance zero and bias equal to that value minus the target. A variable in[0,1] with mean0.5 has variance at most0.25.
scope: Fictional finite probability laws; no study data or calibration
